commits.message:
Add okhp3-i18n-page-sync: detect translation drift via the site search index

Introduces a lean, deterministic detection skill (universal family) that
reuses a static site's own generated search index as its page inventory,
compares each in-scope English page against its configured target-locale
counterparts using a persisted ledger, and reports missing or stale
translations without ever drafting or publishing content itself. Ships
with a copy-in GitHub Actions workflow template that requires no secrets
and calls no external API.
commits.author: Jamie Hill
